lines.en: My tail wiggles and the water pushes me.

lines.zh: 一摆一摆，游得比走得快。
lines.en: Wiggle, wiggle. Swimming beats walking.
That stone ahead is enormous.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我了，等我一下。
lines.en: Weeds caught me. One moment.
I follow my brother. Do not fall behind.
Underwater is much cooler than the bank.
My tail is quicker than my legs.
These ripples are circles I pushed out.

lines.zh: 游到浅一点的地方晒太阳。
lines.en: Swim where it is shallow and sun myself.

lines.zh: 我还没长腿，只能这样走。
lines.en: No legs yet. This is how I get around.
When we swim together, the water sings.

lines.zh: 这池塘我闭着眼都认识。
lines.en: I know this pond with my eyes shut.
Mud below. Do not stir it up.
I float up for a gulp of air.
I chase a fallen leaf in circles.

lines.zh: 泥里冒了个泡，我去顶它一下。
lines.en: A bubble rose from the mud; I bump it.
I blew a bubble. It has not popped.
The weeds sway. The water sways them.

lines.zh: 我数了数，我们一共五只。
lines.en: I counted. There are five of us.
A frog is calling from the bank.

lines.zh: 我等着长腿，等得犯困了。
lines.en: I wait for legs, and waiting makes me sleepy.

lines.zh: 这片水底有很多小石子。
lines.en: Lots of little pebbles down here.

lines.zh: 我看见自己的影子在水面。
lines.en: I see my shadow on the surface.
Stay still. A dragonfly is dipping.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起就不冷了。
lines.en: Huddled together, we are not cold.
My tail moves all on its own.
A bird's shadow on the surface. Dive.
My gills open and close.
The mud at the pond's edge is warm.
Who flipped that lily pad over?
Your face is huge, like a stone.
You bend down. Are you looking at me?

lines.zh: 你的影子把水面挡住了。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks the light.
Are you going to scoop me up?
What is it like outside the water?
That bucket in your hand. I have seen one.
Your finger is longer than I am.

lines.zh: 我在你眼睛里看见了池塘。
lines.en: I see a pond in your eyes.
Do not step on us. We are tiny.
You stand still as a reed.
Whoa. I nearly got sucked in.
My tail hurts. Not the tail.

lines.zh: 我被撞翻了，翻回来就好。
lines.en: I got flipped. I will flip back.
The water went murky. I cannot see.
It hurts, but I dare not cry out.
My scales are not hard yet.
Who stepped on me?
I am hidden. Stop looking.
I will forget this when I grow up.
We seem to be one fewer.
Those crumbs you scattered, are they food?
My mouth is open. Drop it in.
I am not picky. I eat what the water gives.
Bread crumbs are dry. They make me choke.

lines.zh: 你晃手指，我以为是虫子。
lines.en: You wiggle a finger. I thought it was a bug.
I smell nothing, but it looks edible.
Not too much. The pond will foul.
Everyone is here. Scatter more.
I bit it. It did not give.
Feed me and I will swim after you.
Your bump shook the whole pond.
Careful. I am one finger long.

lines.zh: 挤一挤更暖，但不许压我。
lines.en: Squeezing is warm, but do not squash me.
You knocked my tail crooked.
You stepped down and the bottom went dark.
One bump and I spun three times.
Everyone scattered. Come back.

lines.zh: 你的靴子把泥带进来了。
lines.en: Your boots brought mud in.
I hid in the crack of a stone.
Not the net. The net tangles me.
I am too young for that.
Ask me once I am a frog.

lines.zh: 我的兄弟姐妹都在这里。
lines.en: All my brothers and sisters are here.
We hatched from the same clutch.

lines.zh: 你找错人了，我连腿都没有。
lines.en: Wrong one. I do not even have legs.
Mother frog waits on the bank.

lines.zh: 两只会一起游，就这样而已。
lines.en: Two of us swim together. That is all.

lines.zh: 长大以后要跳得高才行。
lines.en: You have to jump high when you grow up.

lines.zh: 别把我俩放进一个桶里。
lines.en: Do not put the two of us in one bucket.
Ask again when spring comes.
I have been put in a bucket.
This bucket rocks. I feel dizzy.
Where are you taking me?
The water in this bucket is colder.
I found a pebble and keep it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 别把我放在沙子上，会干。
lines.en: Not on the sand. I will dry out.
Bring some weed too, for the trip.
I want to go back. The pond is that way.
Leave a gap in the lid. Please.
I grabbed your finger. It is slippery.
Something moves in the water. Something big.
Is that an axolotl? Scatter!
It is swimming toward us.
I hide under a leaf.
Who slapped the surface?
That fish is too close.
Do not all crowd in one spot.
My tail has gone stiff.
A big shadow covers the sun.
To the shallows. It cannot follow.
It circles. I curl up and stay still.
I skim the mud bottom. Quiet now.
Each of its moves pushes the water at me.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就钻石头缝。
lines.en: One more inch and I squeeze into the rocks.
On three, we all swim.

lines.zh: 它看不见我们，水是浑的。
lines.en: It cannot see us. The water is murky.
My heart beats faster than my tail.
Do not look back. Just swim.
It is gone. The surface is calm.
I breathed out. A bubble escaped.
I bit it. It felt nothing.

lines.zh: 我的力气只够推开水草。
lines.en: All my strength can only push a weed.

lines.zh: 别过来，我会撞你的鼻子。
lines.en: Come closer and I will bump your nose.

lines.zh: 我打的这一下，像水泡破。
lines.en: My hit feels like a popping bubble.
My tail slapped its face.

lines.zh: 就这一下，我已经用尽全力。
lines.en: That was one hit. I am spent.
It actually backed off a little.
All of us together. Ram it.
I bit down on one of its fins.
Run. I cannot beat that thing.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来了，水好亮。
lines.en: Out of the egg. The water is so bright.
Five of us hatched from this clutch.
My tail is brand new.

lines.zh: 青蛙妈妈把我们留在这里。
lines.en: Mother frog left us here.

lines.zh: 第一次看见水面外的光。
lines.en: First sight of light beyond the surface.
I tried to move, and I was swimming.
The water is full of our shadows.
Do not crowd. We are all small and new.
This pond will be ours.
No legs yet. I will swim for now.
Why is the water's edge so hot?
Fell from water onto stone. That hurt.

lines.zh: 我能在水里呼吸，怎么会淹？
lines.en: I breathe water. How could I drown?
The whole pond shook at once.
Something shot down from the bank.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，像被电了一下。
lines.en: My skin tingles like a shock.
No food in the water. My belly is empty.
Thunder struck the pond. The water lit up.

lines.zh: 没有水的地方，我不敢想。
lines.en: A place with no water. I dare not imagine.
